categories.unsupported-by-design: Rejected intentionally with passing diagnostic evidence; no fallback path is provided.
categories.future-owned-by-separate-phase: Documented separately because at least one required evidence direction is not passing.

rows.capability: crate-backed Arrow and tensor runtime exchange
rows.notes: Generated package evidence executes exact-pinned Arrow, DataFusion, Polars, ndarray, and CPU-only Candle bridges; observes Arrow schema plus a Polars dataframe derived from the Arrow values by an explicit copy, tensor dtype/rank/shape/layout/stride/device identity, allocation-preserving Sifr-to-Arrow/ndarray/Candle inputs, a safe DLPack-style ownership-and-metadata transfer without the unsafe C ABI, and the owner active before consuming close and released exactly once afterward; and rejects schema, shape/rank, and device mismatches before Cargo.

Exact-pinned generated package evidence executes a hermetic Axum loopback, observes tower-http response middleware, and compiles a SQLx query macro from checked-in offline metadata. Sifr forces SQLX_OFFLINE, removes inherited DATABASE_URL, and under the default SQLx cache search includes package/workspace .sqlx roots for every resolved bridge backend in probe and generated-build cache identity. A backend-package .env deliberately exposes an armed DATABASE_URL; the valid control reaches Cargo without connecting, making the offline forcing load-bearing. Missing or stale metadata is rejected before Cargo starts as SIFR-RUST-CARGO-0001. This bridge-scoped claim does not imply product-level web framework support.

Exact-pinned generated package evidence executes clap parsing, a tracing event filtered by tracing-subscriber env-filter, and internal anyhow context mapped into a declared CliError bridge; direct anyhow::Error return surfaces are rejected with SIFR-RUST-TYPE-0001.

Generated package evidence compiles exact-pinned cc, bindgen, cxx, and zstd wrappers with locked/offline/frozen Cargo; compares byte-identical fresh-build artifacts; executes the artifacts and a zstd encode/decode roundtrip through generated Sifr package glue; validates the exact Apple/GNU arm64/x86_64 native-link envelope after Cargo; and rejects missing direct native-link trust before an armed build script can create its sentinel.

Generated package evidence compiles exact-pinned upstream serde_derive plus the direct derive and prost-build wrappers under locked/offline/frozen Cargo, compares byte-identical prost output from two fresh builds, runtime-observes the wrapper-macro execution and generated schema markers, binds proc-macro trust into cache identity, and rejects missing direct proc-macro or build-script trust before either armed sentinel executes.

Package check/build/run preserve locked, offline, and frozen resolution through Rust probes and generated builds for exact-pinned indexmap with default features disabled; generated locks are authority-validated and immutable; warm constrained probes reuse their cache; and missing, stale, checksum, source, or feature drift is rejected without network access as SIFR-RUST-CARGO-0001.
